const ROWS=[['あ','い','う','え','お'],['か','き','く','け','こ'],['さ','し','す','せ','そ'],['た','ち','つ','て','と'],['な','に','ぬ','ね','の'],['は','ひ','ふ','へ','ほ'],['ま','み','む','め','も'],['や',null,'ゆ',null,'よ'],['ら','り','る','れ','ろ'],['わ',null,null,null,'を'],['ん',null,null,null,null]];
const KANA=new Map();ROWS.forEach((r,x)=>r.forEach((c,y)=>{if(c)KANA.set(c,{x,y});}));
const BLOCKED=new Set(['うんこ','うんち']);
const valid=w=>typeof w==='string'&&[...w].length===3&&![...w].some(c=>!KANA.has(c))&&!BLOCKED.has(w);
const area2=w=>{if(!valid(w))return null;let [a,b,c]=[...w].map(ch=>KANA.get(ch));return Math.abs((b.x-a.x)*(c.y-a.y)-(c.x-a.x)*(b.y-a.y));};
const score=w=>area2(w)/2;
const escape=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const shuffle=list=>{let a=[...list];for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a;};
const pick=a=>a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)];
const allWords=new Set([...(window.MS_BASE_WORDS||[]),...cfg.extra.split(/\s+/),...cfg.bossAnswers,'いろん']);
for(const q of window.MS_QUESTIONS||[])[q.enemy,q.win,q.draw,q.lose].forEach(w=>allWords.add(w));
const overrides=(()=>{try{const draft=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('makesense-admin-draft-v1')||'null');if(draft?.questions&&draft?.words)return draft;}catch{}return window.MS_ADMIN_DATA||{};})();
for(const q of overrides.questions||[])[q.enemy,q.win,q.draw,q.lose].forEach(w=>allWords.add(w));
for(const a of [...(window.MS_EXTRA_WORDS||[]),...(overrides.words||[])])allWords.add(typeof a==='string'?a:a.word);
const dictionary=new Set([...allWords].filter(valid));
const categoryWords=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(cfg.tags).map(([id,t])=>[id,t.split(/\s+/).filter(w=>dictionary.has(w)&&area2(w)<40)]));
const tagToGroup={果物:'fruit',野菜:'vegetable',植物:'vegetable',魚:'fish',魚介:'fish',生き物:'animal',動物:'animal',雑貨:'goods',道具:'goods',日用品:'goods',衣類:'goods'};
for(const item of [...(window.MS_EXTRA_WORDS||[]),...(overrides.words||[])]){
 if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||!dictionary.has(item.word)||scoreSafe(item.word)>=20)continue;
 for(const tag of item.tags||[]){const group=tagToGroup[tag]||tag;if(categoryWords[group]&&!categoryWords[group].includes(item.word))categoryWords[group].push(item.word);}
}
function scoreSafe(w){return area2(w)/2;}
const person=id=>cfg.places.find(p=>p.id===id);
const PIDS=cfg.places.map(p=>p.id);
const exam=[...cfg.tutorial,cfg.randomizer,...cfg.places.filter(p=>p.first).map(p=>p.first)];
const assertions=[];
for(const q of exam){if(!valid(q.enemy)) assertions.push('invalid enemy '+q.enemy);for(const w of q.options)if(!valid(w))assertions.push('invalid option '+w);if(q.options.every(w=>area2(w)<=area2(q.enemy)))assertions.push('no winning option '+q.enemy);}
if(assertions.length)console.error('RPG data validation:',assertions);
const fixed={veg:cfg.places[0].first,fish:cfg.places[1].first,goods:cfg.places[3].first,print:cfg.places[4].first};
const pair=w=>[w.slice(0,2),w.slice(1,3)];
const sharePair=(a,b)=>pair(a).some(p=>pair(b).includes(p));
const fixedQuery=(id)=>{const q=fixed[id];return q?{...q,id:'FIRST-'+id,place:id}:null;};
const bank={veg:[],fish:[],animal:[],goods:[],print:[]};
// Existing hand-curated B/C questions are retained whenever they fit their actual location.
const baseQuestions=new Map((window.MS_QUESTIONS||[]).map(q=>[q.id,q]));
(overrides.questions||[]).forEach(q=>{if(q?.id)baseQuestions.set(q.id,q);});
for(const q of baseQuestions.values()){
 if(overrides.disabledIds?.includes(q.id)||q.status==='不採用')continue;
 const ws=[q.enemy,q.win,q.draw,q.lose];if(ws.some(w=>!valid(w))||new Set(ws).size!==4||area2(q.enemy)===0||area2(q.win)<=area2(q.enemy)||area2(q.draw)!==area2(q.enemy)||area2(q.lose)>=area2(q.enemy))continue;
 const matching=[];
 if(q.genre==='B'){
  if(ws.every(w=>categoryWords.fruit.includes(w)||categoryWords.vegetable.includes(w))){const fam=ws.every(w=>categoryWords.fruit.includes(w))?'fruit':ws.every(w=>categoryWords.vegetable.includes(w))?'vegetable':null;if(fam)matching.push('veg');}
  if(ws.every(w=>categoryWords.fish.includes(w)))matching.push('fish');
  if(ws.every(w=>categoryWords.animal.includes(w)))matching.push('animal');
  if(ws.every(w=>categoryWords.goods.includes(w)))matching.push('goods');
 }
 if(q.genre==='C'&&ws.some(w=>ws.every(t=>sharePair(t,w)))){
  const common=pair(ws[0]).find(p=>ws.every(w=>pair(w).includes(p)));
  if(common)matching.push('print');
 }
 for(const id of matching)bank[id].push({id:q.id,enemy:q.enemy,options:[q.win,q.draw,q.lose],place:id});
}
const addGenerated=(id,group,limit=24)=>{
 const arr=[...new Set(group)].filter(w=>valid(w)&&score(w)<20), used=new Set(bank[id].map(q=>q.enemy));
 for(const enemy of shuffle(arr.filter(w=>score(w)>0))){if(bank[id].length>=limit)break;
  if(used.has(enemy))continue;
  const winners=shuffle(arr.filter(w=>w!==enemy&&score(w)>score(enemy)));
  const others=shuffle(arr.filter(w=>w!==enemy&&w!==winners[0]));
  if(!winners.length||others.length<2)continue;
  const options=shuffle([winners[0],...others.slice(0,2)]);
  bank[id].push({id:'GEN-'+id+'-'+enemy,place:id,enemy,options});used.add(enemy);
 }
};
// Distinct produce groups: one puzzle never mixes fruit and vegetables.
addGenerated('veg',categoryWords.fruit,12);addGenerated('veg',categoryWords.vegetable,26);
addGenerated('fish',categoryWords.fish,22);addGenerated('animal',categoryWords.animal,24);addGenerated('goods',categoryWords.goods,24);
const printWords=[...dictionary].filter(w=>score(w)<20);
const printPairs=new Map();for(const w of printWords)for(const p of pair(w)){if(!printPairs.has(p))printPairs.set(p,new Set());printPairs.get(p).add(w);}
for(const [p,g] of printPairs){if(g.size<4||bank.print.length>=26)continue;const arr=[...g];for(const enemy of shuffle(arr.filter(w=>score(w)>0))){let upper=shuffle(arr.filter(w=>score(w)>score(enemy))),rest=shuffle(arr.filter(w=>w!==enemy&&w!==upper[0]));if(upper.length&&rest.length>=2){bank.print.push({id:'GEN-print-'+p+'-'+enemy,enemy,options:shuffle([upper[0],...rest.slice(0,2)]),place:'print',pair:p});break;}}}
if(bank.print.length<6){for(const q of baseQuestions.values())if(q.genre==='C'&&q.enemy&&q.win&&q.draw&&q.lose&&valid(q.enemy)&&valid(q.win)&&valid(q.draw)&&valid(q.lose)&&area2(q.win)>area2(q.enemy))bank.print.push({id:'BACKUP-'+q.id,enemy:q.enemy,options:[q.win,q.draw,q.lose],place:'print'});}
const STORE='makesense-rpg-pixel-v12';
const defaultState=()=>({version:1,screen:'intro',step:0,question:null,questionIndex:[],first:{},used:{veg:[],fish:[],animal:[],goods:[],print:[]},visited:[],winsBy:{veg:0,fish:0,animal:0,goods:0,print:0},stars:[],questDone:[],discovered:[],examined:[],compared:[],hintLevel:0,bossLosses:0,bossAttempts:0,bossInput:'',bossMs:60000,bossAt:null,bossRate:0,bossResult:null,pending:null,history:[],cleared:false,clearStats:null,notice:null,lastPlace:null,uiPlace:null,total:0,wins:0,draws:0,losses:0});
let state;
try{const d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'null');state=d?.version===1?Object.assign(defaultState(),d):defaultState();}catch{state=defaultState();}
const persist=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(state));}catch{}};
const toast=m=>{const e=$('#toast');e.textContent=m;e.classList.add('toast--show');clearTimeout(toast.t);toast.t=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove('toast--show'),3000);};
const discover=ws=>{for(const w of ws)if(valid(w)&&!state.discovered.includes(w))state.discovered.push(w);};
const nameScore=w=>escape(w)+((state.hintLevel>=1||state.examined.includes(w))&&valid(w)?`<span class="word-score">（${score(w)}）</span>`:'');
const availableQuests=()=>state.cleared?2:state.compared.length>=6?2:state.compared.length>=2?1:0;
const done=id=>state.questDone.includes(id), starred=id=>state.stars.includes(id);
function settle(){if(state.bossAt!==null&&state.bossRate>0){const now=Date.now();state.bossMs=Math.max(0,state.bossMs-(now-state.bossAt)*state.bossRate);state.bossAt=now;}}
function record(enemy,chosen,outcome,who,id){state.total++;state[outcome==='WIN'?'wins':outcome==='DRAW'?'draws':'losses']++;state.history.push({n:state.total,enemy,chosen,outcome,who,id,at:new Date().toISOString()});state.pending={enemy,chosen,outcome,who,id};if(chosen&&valid(chosen))discover([enemy,chosen]);persist();}
function recordBossLoss(reason){if(state.bossResult)return;state.bossRate=0;state.bossAt=null;state.bossMs=0;state.bossLosses++;state.bossResult='LOSE';record('いろん',reason,'LOSE','異論','BOSS-'+state.bossAttempts);state.screen='result';state.notice='異論に届かなかった。';persist();}
// A reload or tab close during the boss encounter counts as a timeout, never a fresh 60-second attempt.
if(state.screen==='boss'||(state.screen==='result'&&state.pending?.who==='異論'&&state.pending?.outcome==='DRAW'))recordBossLoss('時間切れ');
const tally=()=>`<div class="status-figures"><span>${state.total}<small>戦</small></span><i></i><span>${state.bossAttempts}<small>異論への挑戦</small></span></div>`;
const btn=(action,label,klass='button--subtle',extra='')=>`<button type="button" class="button ${klass}" data-action="${action}" ${extra}>${label}</button>`;
const cap=t=>`<div class="micro-label">${t}</div>`;
const imageSrc=n=>window.MS_INLINE_ART?.[n]||`assets/${n}.png`;
const portraits={"スウ・チー":"su","シュウ・キ・ヒョウ":"shu","タ・イジュウ":"ta","ケタチ・ガイ":"keta","ゼン・アーク":"zen","ランダ・マイザ":"randa","ヤオさん":"veg","ウオスケ":"fish","ミオ":"animal","ヨロズ":"goods","カツジ":"print","異論":"boss"};
const portrait=n=>`<img class="pixel-character" src="${imageSrc(portraits[n]||'scholar')}" alt="${escape(n)}のドット絵" width="192" height="256">`;
const roomOf=q=>q?.kind==='randomizer'?'randa':q?.kind==='explore'?q.place||state.lastPlace:'tutorial';

function render(){
 const app=$('#app');const fn={intro:introView,story:storyView,battle:battleView,result:resultView,'randa-intro':randaIntroView,map:mapView,place:placeView,lab:labView,quests:questsView,boss:bossView,clear:clearView};app.innerHTML=(fn[state.screen]||mapView)();if(document.body?.dataset)document.body.dataset.scene=state.screen;$('#log-count').textContent=state.history.length;$('#book-count').textContent=state.discovered.length;
 if(state.screen==='boss'){state.bossAt=Date.now();state.bossRate=$('#overlay').open?.2:1;persist();updateClock();}
 window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
function introView(){return `<section class="pixel-intro"><div class="pixel-intro__scene"><div class="pixel-intro__sun" aria-hidden="true">✦</div><span class="pixel-intro__banner">ことばが力になる街へようこそ</span><div class="pixel-intro__center"><div class="pixel-intro__tag">A LITTLE TOWN, A GREAT OBJECTION</div><h1 class="pixel-logo">メイク<span>センス</span><small>MAKE SENSE</small></h1><p>筋を通すこと。そして、異論を覆すこと。</p></div></div><div class="pixel-intro__foot"><p>ここでは、言葉を交わすことが何よりの勝負。<br>街の人たちと出会い、言葉を集め、誰にも覆せない「異論」に挑もう。</p>${state.step||state.total?btn('resume','▶ 続きから','button--primary button--large'):btn('begin','▶ 冒険をはじめる','button--primary button--large')}<span>進行状況は自動保存。旧作のセーブデータには影響しません。</span></div></section>`;}
function storyView(){const isEnd=state.notice==='explore';if(isEnd)return `<section class="story-page">${cap('A NEW JOURNEY')}<h1>この世界には、<br>まだ知らない言葉がある。</h1><p>言葉を集めるもよし。自分の考えを信じて挑むもよし。<br>研究も依頼も、異論を覆すための必須条件ではありません。</p><p class="story-strong">異論には、いつでも挑戦できます。</p>${btn('map','探索を始める ↗','button--primary button--large')}</section>`;
 return `<section class="story-page">${cap('PROLOGUE')}<h1>メイクセンス。</h1><p>それは、筋を通すこと。<br>そして、異論を覆すこと。</p><p>この世界には、強さを宿す言葉がある。<br>人々は言葉を交わし、日々勝敗を決めてきた。</p><p>しかし、誰も覆すことのできない言葉がある。<br>その名は、<strong>「異論」</strong>。</p><p class="story-strong">君は、異論を覆すことができるだろうか。</p>${btn('next-story','挑戦する ↗','button--primary button--large')}</section>`;}
function randaIntroView(){return `<section class="randa-encounter"><div class="randa-encounter__eyebrow">!　新たな気配を感じる　!</div><div class="randa-encounter__stage"><div class="randa-encounter__sprite">${portrait('ランダ・マイザ')}</div><div class="randa-encounter__unknown">???</div></div><div class="randa-encounter__dialogue"><span>UNKNOWN CHALLENGER</span><h1>ランダ・マイザ</h1><p>「ちょっと待って。5人とも倒したんだ。<br>じゃあ、次は僕とも遊ぼうよ。」</p><small>……今までの勝負とは、何かが違う。</small></div>${btn('randa-start','▶ 挑戦を受ける','button--primary button--large')}</section>`;}
function currentQuestion(){if(state.screen==='battle'&&state.question?.kind==='explore')return state.question;if(state.step<5)return {...cfg.tutorial[state.step],id:'T'+state.step,who:cfg.tutorial[state.step].name,kind:'tutorial'};if(state.step===5)return {...cfg.randomizer,id:'RANDOMIZER',who:'ランダ・マイザ',kind:'randomizer'};return state.question;}
function startQuestion(id){let q;if(!state.first[id]){q=fixedQuery(id);state.first[id]=true;}if(!q){const available=bank[id].filter(x=>!state.used[id].includes(x.id));if(!available.length)state.used[id]=[];const pool=available.length?available:bank[id];q=pick(pool)||fixedQuery(id);}
if(!q){toast('この施設の問題を準備中です。');return;}state.used[id].push(q.id);state.question={...q,who:person(id).person,kind:'explore'};state.screen='battle';discover([q.enemy,...q.options]);persist();render();}
function battleView(){const q=currentQuestion();if(!q)return mapView();const place=state.lastPlace?person(state.lastPlace):null;const choices=state.questionIndex.length===3?state.questionIndex:q.options;
 const league=q.kind==='tutorial'?`第${state.step+1}の試練 / 5`:q.kind==='randomizer'?'突如現れた挑戦者':place?.name||'探索';
 const line=q.line||place?.line||'';const special=q.kind==='randomizer';const loc=roomOf(q);
 return `<section class="game-view pixel-battle ${special?'pixel-battle--randa':''}"><div class="game-topline"><div class="breadcrumb">${special?'⚠ UNEXPECTED CHALLENGER':escape(league)}</div>${tally()}</div><div class="battle-grid"><aside class="enemy-panel"><div class="pixel-battle__room pixel-battle__room--${loc}" style="background-image:url('${imageSrc('room-'+loc)}')"><div class="pixel-battle__portrait">${portrait(q.who)}</div>${special?'<div class="glitch-mark">! ? !</div>':''}</div><div class="enemy-panel__identity"><div class="enemy-panel__role">${special?'秩序を乱す者':escape(league)}</div><h1>${escape(q.who)}</h1><p class="enemy-panel__line">「${escape(line)}」</p><p class="enemy-panel__footer">${q.kind==='explore'?'現在の連勝 '+state.winsBy[state.lastPlace]+' / 5':q.kind==='tutorial'?'勝利すると次の試練へ': 'いつもの勝負とは違う、何かがある。'}</p></div></aside><article class="challenge-panel"><div class="challenge-panel__top">${cap(special?'RULE BREAKER':'WORD BATTLE')}<span class="challenge-panel__seq">${special?'?!':escape(q.id)}</span></div><p class="challenge-panel__prompt">相手の言葉より、<span>強い言葉</span>を選べ。</p><div class="enemy-word">${nameScore(q.enemy)}</div><div class="choice-list">${choices.map((w,i)=>`<button class="choice" data-action="answer" data-word="${escape(w)}" data-light="${escape(w)}"><span class="choice__index">${['壱','弐','参'][i]}</span><span class="choice__word">${nameScore(w)}</span><span class="choice__arrow">▶</span></button>`).join('')}</div><p class="challenge-panel__foot">言葉を選んで決定。結果は対戦ログに残ります。</p></article></div>${state.hintLevel===2?kanaChart(null,true):''}${q.kind==='explore'?`<div class="rpg-under">${btn('map','← 街へ戻る')}</div>`:''}</section>`;}
function outcome(enemy,chosen){return area2(chosen)>area2(enemy)?'WIN':area2(chosen)===area2(enemy)?'DRAW':'LOSE';}
function answer(w){const q=currentQuestion();if(!q||!q.options.includes(w))return;const result=outcome(q.enemy,w);record(q.enemy,w,result,q.who,q.id);state.pending={...state.pending,kind:q.kind,place:state.lastPlace,line:result==='WIN'?q.winLine||'':null};if(q.kind==='randomizer'){state.randomizerDone=true;state.randomizerResult=result;}if(q.kind==='explore'){let p=state.lastPlace;state.winsBy[p]=result==='WIN'?state.winsBy[p]+1:0;if(state.winsBy[p]>=5&&!starred(p)){state.stars.push(p);state.notice='star';}if(!state.visited.includes(p))state.visited.push(p);if(state.visited.length>=3&&!state.labUnlocked)state.labUnlocked=true;}
state.screen='result';state.questionIndex=[];persist();render();}
function resultView(){const p=state.pending||{};const boss=p.who==='異論';const outcomeLabel=p.outcome||'LOSE';const text=boss?(p.outcome==='WIN'?'君は、異論を覆した。':p.outcome==='DRAW'?'異論と互角。残り時間でもう一度。':'君は異論を覆すことができなかった。') : p.kind==='randomizer'?({WIN:'へえ、僕の負けか。それなら、異論にも挑んでみる？',DRAW:'引き分けか。……面白いね。ほかの人たちとも戦ってみたら？',LOSE:'残念。僕の勝ちだね。この先には、僕よりも強い相手がいるよ。'}[outcomeLabel]):p.kind==='tutorial'?(outcomeLabel==='WIN'?p.line:'もう一度、同じ相手に挑戦しよう。'):({WIN:'見事な勝利。',DRAW:'互角の勝負だった。',LOSE:'新しい結果が、次の手掛かりになる。'}[outcomeLabel]);
 const footer=state.notice==='star'&&p.kind==='explore'?'<p class="star-earned">★ 5連勝達成！ ★ を獲得しました。</p>':'';
 let actions='';if(boss&&outcomeLabel==='DRAW'){actions=btn('boss-draw','残り時間で再入力 ↗','button--primary');}
 else if(boss&&outcomeLabel==='LOSE'){actions=btn('explore-intro','探索へ進む ↗','button--primary');}
 else if(boss&&outcomeLabel==='WIN'){actions=btn('clear','クリア画面へ ↗','button--primary');}
 else if(p.kind==='tutorial'){actions=btn('next-tutorial',outcomeLabel==='WIN'?'次の相手へ ↗':'もう一度挑戦 ↗','button--primary');}
 else if(p.kind==='randomizer'){actions=btn(outcomeLabel==='WIN'?'first-boss':'explore-intro',outcomeLabel==='WIN'?'異論に挑む ↗':'探索へ進む ↗','button--primary');}
 else actions=btn('next-explore','同じ施設で続ける ↗','button--primary')+btn('map','探索マップへ');
 return `<section class="outcome-view outcome-view--${outcomeLabel.toLowerCase()}"><div class="outcome-view__top">BATTLE RESULT</div><div class="outcome-view__seal">${outcomeLabel==='WIN'?'✧':outcomeLabel==='DRAW'?'＝':'×'}</div><div class="outcome-view__status">${outcomeLabel}</div><h1>${outcomeLabel==='WIN'?'勝利。':outcomeLabel==='DRAW'?'互角。':'届かなかった。'}</h1><p class="outcome-view__desc">${escape(text)}</p><div class="outcome-compare"><div><small>相手の言葉</small><strong>${nameScore(p.enemy)}</strong></div><span class="outcome-compare__versus">VS</span><div><small>君の言葉</small><strong>${p.chosen==='時間切れ'?escape(p.chosen):nameScore(p.chosen)}</strong></div></div>${boss&&outcomeLabel==='DRAW'?`<p class="timer-inline">残り <strong data-clock>${fmtClock()}</strong></p>`:''}${footer}<div class="outcome-view__actions">${actions}</div>${p.kind==='randomizer'&&outcomeLabel!=='WIN'?'<p class="outcome-view__foot">この世界には、君の知らない言葉が数多く存在する。</p>':''}${boss&&outcomeLabel==='LOSE'?'<p class="outcome-view__foot">この世界には、君の知らない言葉が数多く存在する。</p>':''}${state.hintLevel===2&&!boss?kanaChart(p.chosen,true):''}</section>`;}
function mapView(){
 const lab=!!state.labUnlocked;
 return `<section class="rpg-page pixel-world">${cap(state.cleared?'POST GAME · TOWN':'WELCOME TO TOWN')}
 <div class="rpg-heading"><div><h1>ことばの街</h1><p>曲がった道の先に、顔なじみの店と小さな公園。今日はどこへ行こう？</p></div><div class="rpg-mini-stats"><strong>★ ${state.stars.length}/5</strong><span>街の星あつめ</span></div></div>
 <div class="town-map town-map--lived" aria-label="建物をタップして探索する街の地図">
 <picture class="town-map__art"><source media="(max-width:700px)" srcset="${imageSrc('town-mobile')}"><img class="town-map__ground" src="${imageSrc('town')}" alt="商店街の建物と公園が並ぶ、温かなドット絵の街" width="1920" height="1328"></picture>
 ${cfg.places.map(p=>`<button class="town-spot town-spot--${p.id}" data-action="place" data-id="${p.id}" aria-label="${p.name}に入る"><span class="town-spot__name">${p.name}</span><small>${starred(p.id)?'★ GET':done(p.id)?'✓ 依頼達成':state.winsBy[p.id]+'連勝'}</small></button>`).join('')}
 <button class="town-spot town-spot--lab ${lab?'':'is-locked'}" data-action="lab-gate" aria-label="${lab?'研究室':'謎の建物'}"><span class="town-spot__name">${lab?'研究室':'？？？'}</span></button>
 <div class="town-map__park">ことば公園</div>
 <button class="town-spot town-spot--boss" data-action="boss-start" aria-label="異論に挑戦する"><span class="town-spot__name">異論への道 ▾</span></button>
 </div><div class="town-map__caption"><span>◉ 建物の看板をタップして施設へ</span><span>★ ${state.stars.length}/5　📖 ${state.discovered.length}語</span></div>
 <div class="rpg-primary-action">${state.cleared?btn('clear','クリアポストを見る'):''}</div><p class="rpg-footnote">研究や依頼は任意。異論にはいつでも挑戦できます。</p></section>`;}

function placeView(){let p=person(state.uiPlace)||cfg.places[0],level=availableQuests();return `<section class="rpg-page narrow pixel-place">${btn('map','← 街へ戻る')}${cap('WELCOME · '+p.tag)}<div class="pixel-shop-scene pixel-shop-scene--${p.id}" style="background-image:url('${imageSrc('room-'+p.id)}')"><div class="pixel-shop-scene__sign">${p.name}</div><div class="pixel-shop-scene__keeper">${portrait(p.person)}</div></div><div class="shop-dialogue"><div class="shop-dialogue__name">${p.person}</div><p>「${escape(p.line)}」</p></div><div class="shop-actions"><div class="panel"><div class="panel-top"><h3>⚔ 言葉の勝負</h3><span>${starred(p.id)?'★ 獲得済み':state.winsBy[p.id]+' / 5 連勝'}</span></div><div class="win-track">${[0,1,2,3,4].map(i=>`<i class="${starred(p.id)||i<state.winsBy[p.id]?'lit':''}"></i>`).join('')}</div><p>この人に5連勝すると★獲得。</p>${btn('fight','▶ 勝負する','button--primary','data-id="'+p.id+'"')}</div><div class="panel"><div class="panel-top"><h3>✉ 住人からの依頼</h3><span>${done(p.id)?'達成済み':level>=(p.id==='goods'||p.id==='print'?2:1)?'受注可能':'未解放'}</span></div><p>${level>=(p.id==='goods'||p.id==='print'?2:1)||done(p.id)?escape(p.quest.title):'学者の研究が進むと解放されます。'}</p>${btn('quest-open','依頼を見る',done(p.id)?'button--subtle':'button--primary','data-id="'+p.id+'" '+(level<(p.id==='goods'||p.id==='print'?2:1)&&!done(p.id)?'disabled':''))}</div></div></section>`;}
function labView(){if(!state.labUnlocked&&!state.cleared)return mapView();const lvl=state.compared.length;return `<section class="rpg-page narrow">${btn('map','← 探索マップへ')}${cap('THE SCHOLAR')}<h1>学者の研究室</h1><div class="pixel-lab-scene" style="background-image:url('${imageSrc('room-lab')}')">${portrait('学者')}</div><p>「この装置を使えば、君が見つけた言葉同士の強さを比較できる。何を調べるかは君の自由だ。」</p><div class="panel"><div class="panel-top"><h3>自由比較装置</h3><span>${lvl}組 調査済み</span></div><p>図鑑に登録済みの二語を選ぼう。勝敗に関係なく、異なる組み合わせが研究に加算される。</p><div class="word-pair"><select id="lab-left" aria-label="比較する一つ目の言葉">${wordOptions()}</select><span>VS</span><select id="lab-right" aria-label="比較する二つ目の言葉">${wordOptions(1)}</select></div>${btn('compare','比較する ↗','button--primary')}${state.labComparison?`<div class="lab-result"><strong>${escape(state.labComparison.result)}</strong><span>${nameScore(state.labComparison.a)}　/　${nameScore(state.labComparison.b)}</span></div>`:''}</div><div class="panel"><div class="panel-top"><h3>数値解析</h3><span>${lvl>=6||state.cleared?'使用可能':`${lvl} / 6組`}</span></div>${lvl>=6||state.cleared?`<p>解析した言葉は、以降どの画面でも強さが表示されます。</p><div class="word-pair"><select id="analyse-word" aria-label="解析する言葉">${wordOptions()}</select></div>${btn('analyse','強さを解析する ↗','button--primary')}<p>解析済み：${state.examined.length}語</p>`:'<p>異なる6組を比較すると数値解析が使えるようになります。</p>'}</div><p class="rpg-footnote">研究は任意です。異論にはいつでも挑戦できます。</p></section>`;}
function wordOptions(offset=0){const d=[...state.discovered].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ja'));return d.map((w,i)=>`<option value="${w}" ${i===offset?'selected':''}>${escape(w)}${state.hintLevel||state.examined.includes(w)?'（'+score(w)+'）':''}</option>`).join('');}
const questLevel=p=>p.id==='goods'||p.id==='print'?2:1;
function questCandidates(q,w){if(!valid(w)||w===q.base||w===q.low||w===q.high)return false;const v=score(w),base=score(q.base);
 if(q.category&&!categoryWords[q.category]?.includes(w))return false;
 if(q.type==='higher')return v>base;
 if(q.type==='lower')return v<base;
 if(q.type==='equal')return v===base;
 if(q.type==='double')return v===base*2;
 if(q.type==='between')return v>score(q.low)&&v<score(q.high)&&w.includes(q.pair);
 return false;
}
function questsView(){const p=person(state.uiPlace)||cfg.places[0];if(availableQuests()<questLevel(p)&&!done(p.id))return placeView();let q=p.quest;return `<section class="rpg-page narrow">${btn('place','← '+p.name+'へ','button--subtle','data-id="'+p.id+'"')}${cap('SIDE QUEST · '+(questLevel(p)===1?'初級':'上級'))}<h1>${q.title}</h1><div class="panel"><h3>${p.person}の依頼</h3><p>「${q.text}」</p>${done(p.id)?'<div class="quest-success">✓ 依頼達成済み。ありがとう！</div>':`<label class="select-label" for="quest-word">図鑑から回答する</label><select class="full-select" id="quest-word"><option value="">言葉を選択してください</option>${[...state.discovered].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ja')).map(w=>`<option value="${w}">${escape(w)}${state.hintLevel||state.examined.includes(w)?'（'+score(w)+'）':''}</option>`).join('')}</select>${btn('submit-quest','回答する ↗','button--primary')}<p class="rpg-footnote">※進行度合いによっては、現在の図鑑に正解となる言葉がなく、達成できない場合があります。</p>`}</div><div class="rpg-primary-action">${btn('map','探索マップへ')}</div></section>`;}
const fmtClock=()=>{const ticks=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(state.bossMs/100));const mins=Math.floor(ticks/600),sec=(ticks%600)/10;return `${String(mins).padStart(2,'0')}:${sec.toFixed(1).padStart(4,'0')}`;};
function kanaChart(active,staticOnly=false){const chars=active?[...active]:[];return `<div class="kana-board ${staticOnly?'kana-board--reference':''}"><div class="kana-grid">${[...Array(5)].flatMap((_,y)=>ROWS.map((r,i)=>ROWS[10-i][y]?`<${staticOnly?'span':'button type="button"'} class="${staticOnly?'kana-reference':'kana-button'} ${chars.includes(ROWS[10-i][y])?'kana-lit':''}" ${staticOnly?'':'data-action="kana" data-word="'+ROWS[10-i][y]+'"'}>${ROWS[10-i][y]}</${staticOnly?'span':'button'}>`:`<span class="kana-blank"></span>`)).join('')}</div></div>`;}
function bossView(){const bossLine=state.bossIntro==='direct'?'ランダ・マイザを倒したというのは、君のことか。<br>ならば、試してみるといい。君の言葉で、この異論を覆せるか。':state.bossIntro==='again'?'また来たのか。<br>以前とは違う答えを、見つけられたのかな？':'君が、新たな挑戦者か。<br>ここまでに何を得たのか、その言葉で示してみるといい。';return `<section class="boss-view">${cap('THE FINAL OBJECTION')}<div class="boss-view__center"><div class="pixel-boss-portrait">${portrait('異論')}</div><div class="boss-view__orb"><span>異論</span></div><h1>異論を覆せ。</h1><p>${bossLine}</p><div class="boss-clock"><small>残り時間</small><strong data-clock>${fmtClock()}</strong></div><div class="boss-slots">${[0,1,2].map(i=>`<span class="boss-slot ${state.bossInput[i]?'boss-slot--filled':''}">${state.bossInput[i]||'・'}</span>`).join('')}</div><div class="boss-controls">${btn('boss-back','一文字戻す','button--subtle button--small')}${btn('boss-erase','消去','button--subtle button--small')}</div>${kanaChart(null)}${btn('boss-submit','この言葉で挑む ↗','button--primary boss-submit',state.bossInput.length!==3?'disabled':'')}<p class="boss-view__hint">ひらがな3文字の実在語を入力。辞書にない言葉は判定されません。</p></div></section>`;}
function shareUrl(){
 const url=String(overrides.announcementUrl||'').trim();
 if(/^https:\/\/(?:www\.)?(?:x\.com|twitter\.com)\/[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\/status\/\d+(?:\/)?(?:\?[^\s#]*)?$/.test(url))return url;
 if(/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)&&!['localhost','127.0.0.1'].includes(location.hostname)&&!location.hostname.endsWith('.test'))return location.origin+location.pathname;
 return '';
}
function shareText(){const stars='★'.repeat(state.stars.length),prefix=stars?stars+' ':'';const suffix=stars?' '+stars:'';const n=state.clearStats?.total||state.total, attempts=state.clearStats?.bossAttempts||state.bossAttempts;return `${prefix}『メイクセンス』を${n}戦・異論${attempts}回目の挑戦でクリア！${suffix}\n\n${state.questDone.length===5?'色んな人たちを助けながら、\n':''}異論を覆しました。\n\n#メイク_センス\n${shareUrl()}`.trim();}
function clearView(){return `<section class="clear-view">${cap('GAME CLEAR')}<div class="clear-view__spark">✧</div><h1>異論を、覆した。</h1><p>メイクセンス。それは、筋を通すこと。そして、異論を覆すこと。</p><div class="clear-view__metrics"><div><strong>${state.clearStats?.total||state.total}<small>戦</small></strong><span>クリア時の対戦数</span></div><div><strong>${state.clearStats?.bossAttempts||state.bossAttempts}<small>回</small></strong><span>異論への挑戦</span></div></div><p class="star-earned">${'★'.repeat(state.stars.length)||'☆'} ${state.stars.length} / 5</p>${state.questDone.length===5?'<p class="quest-success">色んな人たちを助けながら、異論を覆しました。</p>':''}<div class="share-preview">${escape(shareText()).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</div><div class="clear-view__actions">${btn('share','Xに投稿する ↗','button--primary')}${btn('copy','投稿文をコピー')}${btn('map','探索を続ける')}</div><p class="clear-view__spoiler">クリア後も★・サブクエストを集められます。投稿文は後からいつでも更新できます。</p></section>`;}
function fallbackCopy(value){try{const t=document.createElement('textarea');t.value=value;t.style.position='fixed';t.style.opacity='0';document.body.appendChild(t);t.select();const ok=document.execCommand('copy');t.remove();toast(ok?'投稿文をコピーしました。':'投稿文をコピーできませんでした。');}catch{toast('投稿文をコピーできませんでした。');}}
function showOverlay(kind){const root=$('#overlay-body');if(kind==='book'){root.innerHTML=`${cap('WORD COLLECTION')}<h2 id="overlay-title">言葉の図鑑</h2><p class="overlay-desc">登場した言葉が自動で登録されます。数値が表示されるのは解析済みの言葉だけ。</p><input class="search-input" id="book-search" placeholder="言葉を検索" autocomplete="off"><div class="word-collection" id="book-list"></div>`;renderBook('');}
 else if(kind==='log'){root.innerHTML=`${cap('BATTLE ARCHIVE')}<h2 id="overlay-title">対戦ログ</h2><div id="log-timer" class="timer-inline">${state.screen==='boss'?'残り <strong data-clock>'+fmtClock()+'</strong>':''}</div><div class="log-summary"><div><b>${state.wins}</b><small>WIN</small></div><div><b>${state.draws}</b><small>DRAW</small></div><div><b>${state.losses}</b><small>LOSE</small></div><div><b>${state.total}</b><small>計</small></div></div><div class="log-list">${[...state.history].reverse().map(h=>`<div class="log-entry"><div class="log-entry__index">#${h.n}<br><span>${escape(h.who)}</span></div><div class="log-entry__words">${nameScore(h.enemy)} <i>VS</i> ${valid(h.chosen)?nameScore(h.chosen):escape(h.chosen)}</div><div class="log-entry__outcome log-entry__outcome--${h.outcome.toLowerCase()}">${h.outcome}</div></div>`).join('')||'<p class="overlay-desc">対戦記録はまだありません。</p>'}</div>`;}
 else{root.innerHTML=`${cap('HOW TO PLAY')}<h2 id="overlay-title">遊び方</h2><div class="rules-prose"><p>相手の3文字より強い言葉を選んで勝負。どの言葉が勝つかは、実際の対戦で確かめよう。</p><p>最初の5戦は勝つまで再挑戦。探索に入った後は、勝敗に関係なく自由に巡れます。選ばなかった選択肢も図鑑に登録されます。</p><p>学者の比較装置や住人からの依頼は、異論を覆すための任意の手段です。</p><p>各施設で5連勝すると★を獲得。異論にはいつでも挑戦でき、60秒以内に強い言葉を示せばクリアです。</p></div>`;}
 if(kind==='log'&&(state.screen==='boss'||(state.screen==='result'&&state.pending?.who==='異論'&&state.pending?.outcome==='DRAW')))setBossRate(.2);$('#overlay').showModal();}
function renderBook(q){const el=$('#book-list');if(!el)return;const words=[...state.discovered].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ja')).filter(w=>w.includes(q));el.innerHTML=words.map(w=>`<span>${nameScore(w)}</span>`).join('')||'<p class="overlay-desc">該当する言葉はありません。</p>';}
function setBossRate(r){settle();state.bossRate=r;state.bossAt=Date.now();persist();if(state.bossMs<=0)recordBossLoss('時間切れ');}
function beginBoss(){state.bossIntro=state.bossAttempts>0?'again':state.randomizerResult==='WIN'?'direct':'explore';state.screen='boss';state.bossInput='';state.bossResult=null;state.bossMs=60000;state.bossAt=Date.now();state.bossRate=1;state.bossAttempts++;persist();render();}
function bossInputChar(ch){if(state.bossInput.length>=3)return;state.bossInput+=ch;persist();renderBossInput();}
function renderBossInput(){if(state.screen!=='boss')return;document.querySelectorAll('.boss-slot').forEach((el,i)=>{el.textContent=state.bossInput[i]||'・';el.classList.toggle('boss-slot--filled',!!state.bossInput[i]);});const submit=$('[data-action="boss-submit"]');if(submit)submit.disabled=state.bossInput.length!==3;}
function bossSubmit(){settle();if(state.bossMs<=0){recordBossLoss('時間切れ');render();return;}const w=state.bossInput;if(!valid(w)){toast('清音のひらがな3文字で入力してください。');return;}if(!dictionary.has(w)){toast('辞書に登録されていない言葉です。時間は進みます。');return;}
 let res=outcome('いろん',w);record('いろん',w,res,'異論','BOSS-'+state.bossAttempts);state.pending.kind='boss';state.bossInput='';state.bossRate=res==='DRAW'?1:0;state.bossAt=res==='DRAW'?Date.now():null;state.bossResult=res==='DRAW'?null:res;
 if(res==='WIN'){state.cleared=true;state.clearStats=state.clearStats||{total:state.total,bossAttempts:state.bossAttempts};}
 if(res==='LOSE')state.bossLosses++;
 state.screen='result';persist();render();}
function checkHintOffer(){if(state.bossLosses>=8&&state.hintLevel<2)toast('ヒント「天啓」が解放されました。図鑑から切り替えできます。');else if(state.bossLosses>=4&&state.hintLevel<1)toast('全単語の数値表示が解放されました。図鑑から切り替えできます。');}
function nextTutorial(){if(state.pending?.outcome==='WIN')state.step++;state.pending=null;state.notice=null;if(state.step===5){state.questionIndex=shuffle(cfg.randomizer.options);state.screen='randa-intro';discover([cfg.randomizer.enemy,...cfg.randomizer.options]);}else{state.questionIndex=shuffle(cfg.tutorial[state.step].options);state.screen='battle';discover([cfg.tutorial[state.step].enemy,...cfg.tutorial[state.step].options]);}persist();render();}
function enterMap(){if(!state.labUnlocked&&state.visited.length>=3)state.labUnlocked=true;state.screen='map';state.notice=null;persist();render();}
const overlay=$('#overlay');overlay.addEventListener('close',()=>{if((state.screen==='boss'||(state.screen==='result'&&state.pending?.who==='異論'&&state.pending?.outcome==='DRAW'))&&state.bossRate>0){setBossRate(1);}});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 const g=e.target.closest('[data-global]');if(g){const x=g.dataset.global;if(x==='close'){overlay.close();return;}if(x==='book'||x==='log'||x==='rules'){if(!overlay.open)showOverlay(x);return;}if(x==='reset'){if(confirm('RPG版のセーブデータをすべて消去しますか？\n旧作のセーブデータは消えません。')){localStorage.removeItem(STORE);location.reload();}return;}if(x==='home'){if(state.screen==='boss'){toast('異論戦の中断は敗北になります。');return;}state.resumeScreen=state.screen;state.screen=state.step<6&&!state.randomizerDone?'intro':'map';persist();render();return;}}
 const b=e.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!b)return;const a=b.dataset.action,id=b.dataset.id;
 if(a==='begin'){state.screen='story';state.notice=null;persist();render();}
 else if(a==='resume'){if(state.step<6&&!state.randomizerDone){state.screen=state.resumeScreen==='result'?'result':state.resumeScreen==='randa-intro'?'randa-intro':'battle';if(state.screen==='battle'&&!state.questionIndex.length)state.questionIndex=shuffle(currentQuestion().options);}else enterMap();state.resumeScreen=null;persist();render();}
 else if(a==='next-story'){state.screen='battle';state.step=0;state.questionIndex=shuffle(cfg.tutorial[0].options);discover([cfg.tutorial[0].enemy,...cfg.tutorial[0].options]);persist();render();}
 else if(a==='randa-start'){state.screen='battle';persist();render();}
 else if(a==='answer')answer(b.dataset.word);
 else if(a==='next-tutorial')nextTutorial();
 else if(a==='explore-intro'){checkHintOffer();state.screen='story';state.notice='explore';persist();render();}
 else if(a==='map')enterMap();
 else if(a==='place'){state.uiPlace=id||state.uiPlace;state.screen='place';persist();render();}
 else if(a==='fight'){state.lastPlace=id;state.uiPlace=id;startQuestion(id);}
 else if(a==='next-explore'){state.notice=null;startQuestion(state.lastPlace);}
 else if(a==='lab-gate'){if(state.labUnlocked||state.cleared){state.screen='lab';persist();render();}else toast('まだ行き方が分からない。各地を巡ってみよう。');}
 else if(a==='quest-open'){state.uiPlace=id;state.screen='quests';persist();render();}
 else if(a==='submit-quest'){const p=person(state.uiPlace),w=$('#quest-word')?.value;if(!w){toast('回答する言葉を選んでください。');return;}if(questCandidates(p.quest,w)){if(!done(p.id))state.questDone.push(p.id);persist();toast('依頼達成！ '+p.person+'から感謝された。');render();}else toast('条件を満たしていないようだ。別の言葉を探してみよう。');}
 else if(a==='compare'){const x=$('#lab-left').value,y=$('#lab-right').value;if(!x||!y||x===y){toast('異なる二つの言葉を選んでください。');return;}let before=state.compared.length;const key=[x,y].sort().join('|');if(!state.compared.includes(key))state.compared.push(key);state.labComparison={a:x,b:y,result:outcome(y,x)};persist();render();if(before<2&&state.compared.length>=2)toast('初級サブクエストが解放されました。');if(before<6&&state.compared.length>=6)toast('数値解析と上級サブクエストが解放されました。');}
 else if(a==='analyse'){const w=$('#analyse-word').value;if(w&&!state.examined.includes(w))state.examined.push(w);persist();render();toast(`${w}の強さは ${score(w)}。以後、数値が表示されます。`);}
 else if(a==='first-boss'||a==='boss-start'){if(state.screen==='boss')return;beginBoss();}
 else if(a==='boss-draw'){if(state.bossMs<=0){recordBossLoss('時間切れ');render();return;}state.screen='boss';state.bossResult=null;state.bossInput='';persist();render();}
 else if(a==='kana'){bossInputChar(b.dataset.word);}
 else if(a==='boss-back'){state.bossInput=state.bossInput.slice(0,-1);persist();renderBossInput();}
 else if(a==='boss-erase'){state.bossInput='';persist();renderBossInput();}
 else if(a==='boss-submit')bossSubmit();
 else if(a==='clear'){state.screen='clear';persist();render();}
 else if(a==='copy'){const value=shareText();if(navigator.clipboard?.writeText){navigator.clipboard.writeText(value).then(()=>toast('投稿文をコピーしました。')).catch(()=>fallbackCopy(value));}else fallbackCopy(value);}
 else if(a==='share'){window.open('https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text='+encodeURIComponent(shareText()),'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');}
});
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.id==='book-search')renderBook(e.target.value);});
document.addEventListener('pointerover',e=>{const el=e.target.closest('[data-light]');if(el&&state.hintLevel===2){const grid=$('.kana-board--reference');if(grid){grid.querySelectorAll('.kana-reference').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('kana-lit',[...el.dataset.light].includes(x.textContent)));}}});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(state.screen==='boss'&&!overlay.open){if(e.key==='Backspace'){e.preventDefault();state.bossInput=state.bossInput.slice(0,-1);renderBossInput();persist();}else if(e.key==='Enter'&&state.bossInput.length===3){e.preventDefault();bossSubmit();}else if(KANA.has(e.key)){bossInputChar(e.key);}}});
let tickMs=0;setInterval(()=>{if(state.screen!=='boss'&&!(state.screen==='result'&&state.pending?.who==='異論'&&state.pending?.outcome==='DRAW'))return;if(state.bossRate<=0)return;settle();if(state.bossMs<=0){recordBossLoss('時間切れ');if(overlay.open)overlay.close();checkHintOffer();render();return;}updateClock();if(Date.now()-tickMs>950){persist();tickMs=Date.now();}},80);
function updateClock(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-clock]').forEach(el=>{el.textContent=fmtClock();el.classList.toggle('clock--urgent',state.bossMs<=10000);});}
// Hint controls are intentionally offered, never automatically applied.
function hintView(){const max=state.bossLosses>=8?2:state.bossLosses>=4?1:0;return `<div class="hint-actions"><span>異論への累計敗北：${state.bossLosses}回</span><select id="hint-level"><option value="0" ${state.hintLevel===0?'selected':''}>通常表示</option>${max>=1?`<option value="1" ${state.hintLevel===1?'selected':''}>全数値表示</option>`:''}${max>=2?`<option value="2" ${state.hintLevel===2?'selected':''}>天啓</option>`:''}</select></div>`;}
const origShow=showOverlay;showOverlay=function(kind){origShow(kind);if(kind==='book'){$('#overlay-body').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="panel hint-panel"><h3>異論戦のヒント</h3><p>4敗で全数値表示、8敗で「天啓」が解放。どちらも任意で切り替えられます。</p>${hintView()}</div>`);}};
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.id==='hint-level'){state.hintLevel=Number(e.target.value)||0;persist();const search=$('#book-search');if(search)renderBook(search.value);toast('ヒント表示を切り替えました。');}});
// Lab unlock is earned in exploration, even when visiting locations in a different order.
render();
window.MSRPG_TEST={score,area2,valid,bank,categoryWords,questCandidates,cfg};
})();

</script></body></html>
